meta.title: Implement register reuse for VM
meta.body_summary: Implement simple liveness analysis to allocate physical registers, update compiler to run register allocation after building a function, and regenerate golden files for VM tests.

perf_labels.notes: Single commit register allocation PR; closed by author after ~2.5h with no review, comments, or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 558 changed lines across 23 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but most churn comes from regenerated golden test output files (the core VM logic is 209 lines in runtime/vm/vm.go). The PR was closed without merge, consistent with lack of review activity or performance validation.

core_change_summary.description: Added liveness analysis and register allocation logic in runtime/vm/vm.go; updated golden test output files (.ir.out and .out) for many VM tests to reflect new register numbers.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Golden file modifications are purely to reflect new register assignments; they do not change test semantics.
